operatorProperties.code:
def process(nifc_state_intersections) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = nifc_state_intersections.drop_duplicates()
    result = df.groupby('NIFC_Abbreviation').size().reset_index(name='state_count')
    result = result.sort_values('state_count', ascending=False)
    return result

operators.customDisplayName: Remove duplicate rows from spatial intersections, group by NIFC abbreviation, count unique states per NIFC area, and sort descending by state count
